scope.snapshot_note: HTML and index were read into memory before concurrent rewrites. Hashes identify the assessed versions; this is not a review of later agent changes.
scope.write_constraint: This audit creates only scripts/content-review-20261019.json. No article content, navigation or index is changed.
scope.excluded_disposition_semantics: Excluded records use retain only as a required-enum no-action sentinel. They are not editorial approvals.

methodology.programmatic: Read complete .detail-content bodies for all 220 index URLs using HTML DOMParser; extracted paragraphs, headings and body sources, compared repeated paragraphs, checked full-document internal file targets and inspected title/intent overlap.
methodology.manual: Examined benefits/seasonal schedules; training-card/course selection; study/qualification pairs; security and facilities work; elder care/health costs; pension/retirement finance; public-site workflows. Read representative complete bodies, compared overlapping cores, and examined all in-scope title/core/headings/source records.
methodology.filler_model: Diagnostic core is text before guide4050-depth-expand, with related-reading and guide-short-uplift removed in memory. It deliberately does not reproduce the main agents exact 55-page cleaner. Core char counts are diagnostic only, not a retention threshold.
methodology.factual_standard: Missing criteria are findings about the body, not assertions that an individual qualifies. Current legal/medical/financial facts require official-source verification at rewrite. Only the automobile-premium contradiction is externally confirmed in this audit. Other source URLs are extracted references, not an assertion of live-link validity.
methodology.navigation_limits: All same-site anchor paths were checked against local files; no missing targets found. This does not establish external HTTP health, fragment validity, menu usability or accessibility.
methodology.retention_standard: Retain means distinct intent and sufficiently useful existing body, not exhaustive line-by-line legal verification. Empty issues arrays are intentional. Brief necessary safety disclaimers are not automatically treated as filler.
